documents.text: The Patents Act 1970 contains exclusions relevant to traditional knowledge, known properties and admixtures under Section 3.
The Nagoya Protocol addresses fair and equitable benefit sharing arising from the utilization of genetic resources.
The Food Safety and Standards Ayurveda Aahara Regulations address qualifying food products, composition, claims and labelling in India.
Directive 2004/24/EC provides a traditional herbal medicinal product registration route in the European Union.
FDA botanical drug development guidance discusses quality controls, nonclinical evidence and clinical development for botanical drugs.
DEMO-EVIDENCE-47 records chromatographic batch identity and a twelve-week stability observation but does not establish clinical efficacy.
